extracted.intended_audience: users/developers of PARI/GP (number theorists, computational algebraists) who use the library functions
extracted.subtask_description: Reference documentation for PARI/GP library routines dealing with relative number fields, norm computations, zeta functions, polynomials and power series, including usage, flags, caveats and algorithmic notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfisnorminit
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute technical data needed by rnfisnorm to solve norm equations N x = a for x in L and a in K, where K is defined by pol and L/K by polrel. pol may be an nf or bnf; if pol has degree 1, polrel may also be an nf, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: flag = 0: do not care whether L/K is Galois; flag = 1: assume L/K is Galois (unchecked, speeds rnfisnorm); flag = 2: determine whether L/K is Galois. Library syntax: GEN rnfisnorminit(GEN pol, GEN polrel, long flag).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfisnorm
rubrics_metrics.description: Checks whether an element a is a norm from L to K using initialization from rnfisnorminit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN rnfisnorm(GEN T, GEN a, long flag). Example given that rnfisnorm(T,17) checks whether 17 is a norm in the specified relative extension (and returns true in example).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfkummer
rubrics_metrics.description: Given bnr (output of bnrinit), and optional congruence subgroup, finds a relative equation for the class field corresponding to the module in bnr and the given congruence subgroup; if subgp omitted, gives the full ray class field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only works for subgroups of prime index; uses Kummer theory by adjoining roots of unity and finds generator via Hecke's ramification characterization in Kummer extensions of prime degree. If extension degree is not prime, user must split extension manually. Usage: GEN rnfkummer(GEN bnr, GEN subgp = NULL, long d, long prec). If d>0 outputs list of all relative equations of degree d contained in the ray class field with same conductor.

rubrics_metrics.name: rnflllgram
rubrics_metrics.description: Given polynomial pol with coefficients in nf and a suborder order of L (maximal rank), returns [neworder, U] where neworder is a reduced order and U the unimodular transformation matrix.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN rnflllgram(GEN nf, GEN pol, GEN order, long prec). Mentioned as basis for incomplete reduction theory of lattices over number fields - implementation deserves improvement.

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfnormgroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Given bnr (big ray class field from bnrinit) and pol defining a relative Abelian extension, computes the norm group (Artin/Takagi group) corresponding to the Abelian extension of bnf = bnr.bnf defined by pol.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assumes the module corresponding to bnr is a multiple of the conductor and that pol indeed defines an Abelian extension; these facts are not checked and the result is undefined if assumptions are false. Result is the HNF defining the norm group on the given generators of bnr.gen. Syntax: GEN rnfnormgroup(GEN bnr, GEN pol).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfpolred (obsolete)
rubrics_metrics.description: Relative version of polred: given monic pol with coefficients in nf, finds list of relative polynomials defining some subfields hopefully simpler and containing the original field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Marked OBSOLETE; use rnfpolredbest instead. Based on incomplete reduction theory implemented by rnflllgram; in version 2.7.7 slower and less efficient than rnfpolredbest. Syntax: GEN rnfpolred(GEN nf, GEN pol, long prec).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfpolredabs (obsolete)
rubrics_metrics.description: Relative version of polredabs: given monic pol with coefficients in nf, finds a simpler relative polynomial defining the same field. Binary digits of flag control additional outputs and behaviors (convert elements, return absolute polynomial, use suborder).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flag bits: 1 add representation conversion; 2 return absolute polynomial; 16 possibly use a suborder (slower when relative discriminant smooth, faster otherwise). Warning: complexity exponential in absolute degree; rnfpolredbest runs in polynomial time and tends to return polynomials with smaller discriminants. Syntax: GEN rnfpolredabs(GEN nf, GEN pol, long flag).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfpolredbest
rubrics_metrics.description: Relative version of polredbest: given monic pol with coefficients in nf, finds a simpler relative polynomial P defining the same field; runs in polynomial time though not necessarily canonical smallest polynomial.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flag bits: 1 return [P,a] with conversion info; 2 return absolute polynomial Pabs; 3 return [Pabs,a,b] where a,b are roots mod Pabs. Syntax: GEN rnfpolredbest(GEN nf, GEN pol, long flag). Example provided demonstrating outputs P, a, Pabs, b and substitutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfpseudobasis
rubrics_metrics.description: Given number field nf (from nfinit) and polynomial pol with coefficients in nf defining relative extension L, computes a pseudo-basis (A,I) for maximal order Z_L viewed as Z_K-module and the relative discriminant of L. Outputs [A, I, D, d].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: D is the relative ideal discriminant and d the relative discriminant as an element of nf^*/nf^{*2}. Syntax: GEN rnfpseudobasis(GEN nf, GEN pol).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfsteinitz
rubrics_metrics.description: Given nf and either a defining polynomial x or a pseudo-basis x, computes another pseudo-basis (A,I) such that all ideals of I except perhaps the last are equal to ring of integers of nf, and outputs [A, I, D, d]. The last ideal class is the Steinitz class of Z_L as Z_K-module.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: GEN rnfsteinitz(GEN nf, GEN x). Note: output ideals not HNF in general.

rubrics_metrics.name: subgrouplist
rubrics_metrics.description: Given bnr (output of bnrinit) or list of cyclic components of finite Abelian group G, outputs list of subgroups of G as HNF left divisors of SNF matrix corresponding to G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If flag=0 and bnr from bnrinit, returns only subgroups whose modulus is the conductor; otherwise modulus not taken into account. If bound present positive integer, restrict to subgroups of index < bound; if bound is [B], return subgroups of index exactly B. Examples show using subgrouplist on [6,2] and bnrinit(bnfinit(x),[120,[1]],1). Library syntax: GEN subgrouplist0(GEN bnr, GEN bound = NULL, long flag).

rubrics_metrics.name: zetak
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute Dedekind zeta function of number field (initialized by zetakinit) at complex x; if flag=1 computes Dedekind Λ function instead (zeta times gamma and exponential factors).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CAVEAT: implementation unsatisfactory, must be rewritten. Accuracy depends on zetakinit accuracy and current real precision; values with large imaginary part or near integers may suffer precision loss. Increasing precision can produce completely wrong results in some cases. Use glambdak or gzetak variants in library mode. Library syntax: GEN gzetakall(GEN nfz, GEN x, long flag, long prec).

rubrics_metrics.name: zetakinit
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute initialization data for computing Dedekind zeta and lambda functions for bnf so zetak can evaluate at current real precision. Returns a 9-component vector of technical components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inefficient: computes millions of Dirichlet series coefficients if precision big. Unlikely to handle more than ~9 digits of relative precision unless discriminant small. May fail with 'bnrL1: overflow in zeta_get_N0 [need too many primes]' if approximate functional equation requires summing too many terms. Can be called with an irreducible polynomial instead of bnf. Syntax: GEN initzeta(GEN bnf, long prec).

rubrics_metrics.name: O(p^e) / zero constructors
rubrics_metrics.description: Constructs zeros with p-adic or series precision: if p>2 integer returns p-adic 0 of precision e; otherwise returns power series zero with precision ev where v is X-adic valuation of p w.r.t main variable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN ggrando(). GEN zeropadic(GEN p, long e) for p-adic and GEN zeroser(long v, long e) for power series zero in variable v.

rubrics_metrics.name: bezoutres (deprecated alias)
rubrics_metrics.description: Deprecated alias for polresultantext (computes Bezout resultants / u,v such that Au+Bv=Res(A,B)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN polresultantext0(GEN A, GEN B, long v = -1).

rubrics_metrics.name: deriv
rubrics_metrics.description: Derivative of x with respect to main variable (or v if given). Derivative of scalar is 0; vector/matrix done componentwise. For t_POLMOD, main variable is main variable among its coefficients; derivative taken w.r.t main variable of base ring.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shortcut x' is allowed if derivative w.r.t main variable. Library syntax: GEN deriv(GEN x, long v = -1).

rubrics_metrics.name: diffop
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply differential operator D specified by variables vector v and values vector d, returning image of x by n-th power of D. D acts componentwise; for t_POLMOD if modulus variable not provided, value derived via implicit function theorem.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Can be used to differentiate formal expressions, propagate relations (example with Sin/Cos), compute Bell polynomials via Faà di Bruno. Library syntax: GEN diffop0(GEN x, GEN v, GEN d, long n). For n=1 use GEN diffop(GEN x, GEN v, GEN d).

rubrics_metrics.name: eval
rubrics_metrics.description: Replaces in x formal variables by values assigned after creation of x (mainly useful in GP). If x is character string, eval executes it as GP command.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not confuse with subst. Syntax: geval(GEN x). A syntax error raises e_SYNTAX which can be trapped.

rubrics_metrics.name: factorpadic
rubrics_metrics.description: p-adic factorization of polynomial pol to precision r giving two-column matrix of factors approximating factorization in Q_p[X]; not same as factorization over Z/p^rZ.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Factors normalized so leading coeff is power of p; uses modified round4 Zassenhaus algorithm. If pol has inexact t_PADIC coefficients, polynomial is made integral by dividing p-adic content and lifting to Z via truncation; advised to only factor polynomials with exact rational coefficients. Examples provided. Syntax: factorpadic(GEN f, GEN p, long r).

rubrics_metrics.name: intformal
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal integration of x wrt main variable or v. PARI cannot represent logarithmic or arctangent terms; such terms cause errors. For rational functions base ring assumed integral domain char 0. For t_POLMOD the main variable is among coefficients; integrating wrt modulus main variable is meaningless.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Errors on poles with non-zero residues. Library syntax: GEN integ(GEN x, long v = -1).

rubrics_metrics.name: padicappr
rubrics_metrics.description: Vector of p-adic roots of pol congruent to p-adic number a modulo p, with same p-adic precision as a. a may be t_PADIC or integral element of finite extension given as t_POLMOD.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a is t_POLMOD in extension, result are roots in same extension. Syntax: GEN padicappr(GEN pol, GEN a). Also Zp_appr alias when a is t_PADIC.

rubrics_metrics.name: padicfields
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns vector of polynomials generating all extensions of degree N of Q_p; N may be [n,d] to specify degree and discriminant p^d.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List minimal: different polynomials generate non-isomorphic extensions. For flags: flag=1 replace each polynomial by [P,e,f,d,c] with ramification index e, residual degree f, discriminant valuation d, number of conjugate fields c; flag=2 return number of extensions (Krasner’s formula) much faster. Syntax: GEN padicfields0(GEN p, GEN N, long flag) or GEN padicfields(GEN p, long n, long d, long flag).

rubrics_metrics.name: polchebyshev
rubrics_metrics.description: Return n-th Chebyshev polynomial of first kind T_n (flag=1) or second kind U_n (flag=2), evaluated at a (x default).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recurrence P_{n+1}=2xP_n - P_{n-1}; initial conditions given. Relations: T_n = n U_{n-1}; T_n(cos z)=cos(nz). Syntax: GEN polchebyshev_eval(long n, long flag, GEN a = NULL). Other variants exist.

rubrics_metrics.name: polcoeff
rubrics_metrics.description: Coefficient of degree n of polynomial x wrt main variable or v. If n greater than degree, returns zero. Applies to scalars, rational functions (denominator monomial), power series (if n < valuation returns zero). For vector/matrix returns component(x,n).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If n greater than largest significant degree on power series, error. Syntax: GEN polcoeff0(GEN x, long n, long v = -1).

rubrics_metrics.name: polcyclo
rubrics_metrics.description: n-th cyclotomic polynomial (n>0) or its evaluation at a.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Algorithm reduces to squarefree n and uses product over divisors with Möbius µ(n/d) in evaluated case; assumes a^d -1 either 0 or invertible for all d|n (if not, use subst). Syntax: GEN polcyclo_eval(long n, GEN a = NULL). Variant GEN polcyclo(long n, long v).

rubrics_metrics.name: polcyclofactors
rubrics_metrics.description: Return vector of polynomials whose product is product of distinct cyclotomic polynomials dividing f.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returned polynomials may be products of cyclotomic polynomials and need not be irreducible. Examples show factor and verification. Syntax: GEN polcyclofactors(GEN f).

rubrics_metrics.name: poldegree
rubrics_metrics.description: Degree of polynomial x in main variable or v. Degree of 0 is fixed negative number (do not rely on exact value); degree of non-zero scalar is 0.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Raises error if x is not polynomial/rational function. Syntax: long poldegree(GEN x, long v = -1).

rubrics_metrics.name: poldisc
rubrics_metrics.description: Discriminant of polynomial pol in main variable or v. Uses modular algorithm over Z or Q, subresultant otherwise. Applies also to t_QUAD and t_QFI/t_QFR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples given. Syntax: GEN poldisc0(GEN pol, long v = -1).

rubrics_metrics.name: poldiscreduced
rubrics_metrics.description: Reduced discriminant vector of integral monic polynomial f: vector of elementary divisors of Z[α]/f(α)Z[α] where α root of f; components positive and product equals absolute discriminant of f.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN reduceddiscsmith(GEN f).

rubrics_metrics.name: polgraeffe
rubrics_metrics.description: Return Graeffe transform g of f such that g(x^2)=f(x)f(-x).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: GEN polgraeffe(GEN f).

rubrics_metrics.name: polhensellift
rubrics_metrics.description: Given prime p, integral polynomial A with leading coef p-unit, vector B of monic polynomials pairwise coprime mod p whose product ≡ A/lc(A) mod p, lift B to polynomials whose product ≡ A mod p^e.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Generalization: if T irreducible mod p and B factorization of A over F_p[t]/(T), lift using p replaced by [p,T]. Example provided. Syntax: GEN polhensellift(GEN A, GEN B, GEN p, long e).

rubrics_metrics.name: polhermite
rubrics_metrics.description: n-th Hermite polynomial H_n evaluated at a (x default), defined by H_n(x) = (-1)^n e^{x^2} d^n/dx^n e^{-x^2}.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: GEN polhermite_eval(long n, GEN a = NULL) or GEN polhermite(long n, long v).

rubrics_metrics.name: polinterpolate
rubrics_metrics.description: Given data vectors X and Y (same length n), find interpolating polynomial through points and evaluate at x; if Y omitted return polynomial interpolating (i,X[i]); optional e returns error estimate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN polint(GEN X, GEN Y = NULL, GEN x = NULL, GEN *e = NULL).

rubrics_metrics.name: poliscyclo
rubrics_metrics.description: Return 0 if f not cyclotomic; return n>0 if f = Φ_n (n-th cyclotomic polynomial).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples given (poliscyclo(x^4-x^2+1)=12 etc.). Syntax: long poliscyclo(GEN f).

rubrics_metrics.name: poliscycloprod
rubrics_metrics.description: Return 1 if f is a product of cyclotomic polynomials, 0 otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows factorization and verification using poliscyclo on factors. Syntax: long poliscycloprod(GEN f).

rubrics_metrics.name: polisirreducible
rubrics_metrics.description: Return 1 if pol is non-constant and irreducible, 0 otherwise; irreducibility checked over smallest base field pol seems defined over.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: long isirreducible(GEN pol).

rubrics_metrics.name: pollead
rubrics_metrics.description: Leading coefficient of polynomial or power series x w.r.t main variable or v.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: GEN pollead(GEN x, long v = -1).

rubrics_metrics.name: pollegendre
rubrics_metrics.description: n-th Legendre polynomial evaluated at a (x default).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: GEN pollegendre_eval(long n, GEN a = NULL) or GEN pollegendre(long n, long v).

rubrics_metrics.name: polrecip
rubrics_metrics.description: Reciprocal polynomial (coefficients in reverse order) of pol; pol must be a polynomial.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: GEN polrecip(GEN pol).

rubrics_metrics.name: polresultant
rubrics_metrics.description: Resultant of two polynomials x and y wrt main variables (or v). Algorithm assumes base ring is a domain. Use polresultantext if u,v with x*u + y*v = Res(x,y) are needed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: flag=0 choose best algorithm (subresultant, modular over Q[X], or Sylvester for inexact); flag=1 use Sylvester determinant (generally slower). Syntax: GEN polresultant0(GEN x, GEN y, long v = -1, long flag).

rubrics_metrics.name: polresultantext
rubrics_metrics.description: Find polynomials U,V such that A*U + B*V = R where R is resultant of A and B; returns [U,V,R]. Uses subresultant algorithm and base ring assumed domain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples provided. Syntax: GEN polresultantext0(GEN A, GEN B, long v = -1). Also available as GEN polresultantext(GEN x, GEN y).

rubrics_metrics.name: polroots
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute complex roots of polynomial x, returned as column vector repeating roots according to multiplicity. Precision controlled by realprecision in GP or second argument in library mode.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Algorithm is modification of A. Schönhage's root-finding by X. Gourdon; guaranteed to converge and give required accuracy barring bugs. Syntax: GEN roots(GEN x, long prec).

rubrics_metrics.name: polrootsmod
rubrics_metrics.description: Row vector of roots modulo p of polynomial pol; multiple roots not repeated. If p very small, set flag=1 to use naive search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example polrootsmod(x^2-1,2) = [Mod(1,2)]. Syntax: GEN rootmod0(GEN pol, GEN p, long flag).

rubrics_metrics.name: polrootspadic
rubrics_metrics.description: Vector of p-adic roots of polynomial pol given to p-adic precision r; p must be prime. Multiple roots not repeated. These are approximations in Z/p^r Z of true roots in Q_p.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If pol has inexact t_PADIC coefficients, polynomial is made integral and lifted; advised to only factor polynomials with exact rational coefficients. Syntax: GEN rootpadic(GEN x, GEN p, long r).

rubrics_metrics.name: polsturm
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of real roots of real squarefree polynomial pol in interval (a,b] using Sturm's algorithm; a or b omitted treated as -∞/+∞ respectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: long sturmpart(GEN pol, GEN a = NULL, GEN b = NULL). Also long sturm(GEN pol) for total number of real roots.

rubrics_metrics.name: polsubcyclo
rubrics_metrics.description: Gives polynomials defining sub-Abelian extensions of degree d of cyclotomic field Q(ζ_n), where d | φ(n). Returns a polynomial if exactly one extension, vector (possibly empty) otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To get vector always, use concat([], polsubcyclo(n,d)). galoissubcyclo can specify which subextension to compute. Syntax: GEN polsubcyclo(long n, long d, long v = -1).

rubrics_metrics.name: polsylvestermatrix
rubrics_metrics.description: Form Sylvester matrix corresponding to polynomials x and y with coefficients put in columns (suitable for solving equations); useful for inexact entries where Euclidean division doesn't make sense.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: GEN sylvestermatrix(GEN x, GEN y).

rubrics_metrics.name: polsym
rubrics_metrics.description: Create column vector of symmetric powers of roots of polynomial x up to power n using Newton's formula.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: GEN polsym(GEN x, long n).

rubrics_metrics.name: poltchebi (deprecated)
rubrics_metrics.description: Deprecated alias for polchebyshev.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: GEN polchebyshev1(long n, long v = -1).

rubrics_metrics.name: polzagier
rubrics_metrics.description: Create Zagier's polynomial P^{(m)}_n used in functions sumalt and sumpos (flag=1), with m ≤ n. Referenced paper for definition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: GEN polzag(long n, long m).

rubrics_metrics.name: serconvol
rubrics_metrics.description: Convolution (Hadamard product) of two power series x and y: if x = Σ a_k X^k and y = Σ b_k X^k then serconvol(x,y) = Σ (a_k*b_k) X^k.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: GEN convol(GEN x, GEN y).

rubrics_metrics.name: serlaplace
rubrics_metrics.description: Map power series x with non-negative exponents and coefficients a_k/k! to series Σ a_k X^k (Laplace-type transform on series).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: GEN laplace(GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: serreverse
rubrics_metrics.description: Reverse power series of s: series t such that t(s) = x; s must have valuation exactly 1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example serreverse(tan(x)) computed. Syntax: GEN serreverse(GEN s).

rubrics_metrics.name: subst
rubrics_metrics.description: Replace simple variable y by argument z in 'polynomial' expression x. Applies recursively to vector/matrix/list entries. If x not genuine polynomial substitution done with scalar components as degree zero polynomials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be careful: substitution by non-square matrix forbidden. For power series z must be polynomial, power series, or rational function. Use substvec or substpol for multiple or polynomial substitutions. Syntax: GEN gsubst(GEN x, long y, GEN z).

rubrics_metrics.name: substpol
rubrics_metrics.description: Replace polynomial variable y (allowed to be any polynomial) by z in expression x: substitution done modulo y - t where t new free variable then t replaced by z. Allows substitutions by polynomials of degree >1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show behavior. Function gdeflate attempts to write T(x) as t(x^d). Syntax: GEN gsubstpol(GEN x, GEN y, GEN z).

rubrics_metrics.name: substvec
rubrics_metrics.description: Simultaneously replace vector v of monomials (variables) by vector w of expressions of same length in expression x; substitutions done simultaneously.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show simultaneous replacement avoids cascading substitutions. Syntax: GEN gsubstvec(GEN x, GEN v, GEN w).

rubrics_metrics.name: sumformal
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal sum of polynomial expression f with respect to main variable or v: returns polynomial F vanishing at 0 such that F(b)-F(a)=Σ_{v=a+1}^b f(v).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show closed form sums for polynomials; syntax GEN sumformal(GEN f, long v = -1). Base ring assumed characteristic zero.

rubrics_metrics.name: taylor
rubrics_metrics.description: Taylor expansion around 0 of x with respect to simple variable t to given order d (adds O(t^d) to components).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contrary to Ser, taylor uses seriesprecision parameter and adds O(t^d) uniformly. Syntax: GEN tayl(GEN x, long t, long precdl).

rubrics_metrics.name: thue
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns all integer solutions (x,y) of Thue equation P(x,y)=a where tnf created with thueinit(P). If sol present, must contain solutions of Norm(x)=a modulo units of positive norm.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If tnf computed without assuming GRH flag then result unconditional; otherwise result may be conditional on GRH except for certain rhs values ±1 or favorable cases. thueinit(P,1) forces unconditional tnf. Reducible or non-monic polynomials allowed. Syntax: thue(tnf,a) with tnf from thueinit.
